attempts.summary: Configured GRE-tap based traffic mirroring: node1 duplicates all IPv4/ARP traffic exchanged with node2 (both directions) onto a gretap tunnel terminating on node3, using tc clsact/flower/mirred on node1's eth0. Node3 sees full copies of node1<->node2 traffic on its local gretap1 interface while the original node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing unmodified over the shared segment. Configuration was made persistent (systemd unit on node1, OpenRC local.d script on node3) and verified to survive a one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes.
